description: Inside ONE declared bounded context (sales), the customer is modelled twice under two names: Customer (id, email, name, lifetimeSpend) and Client (clientId, emailAddress, displayName, creditLimit). Two application services each use one of them. Same context, same ubiquitous language, two models: a defect in DDD terms (N4). Redefines the old case-03, which planted the names across three contexts.

cheapExpectation.why: Different class names, different field names (id/clientId, email/emailAddress, name/displayName); no shared token sequence.
